name: Superhero
definition: A single costumed character record in the superhero catalogue. Each superhero carries a code name, an optional civilian full name, and references to gender, eye/hair/skin colour, race, publisher and alignment, plus nullable physical measurements.
scope: The superhero SQLite database; grain is one row per character in the superhero table.

name: Superhero Code Name
definition: The public alias under which a character appears, stored in superhero.superhero_name. It is the primary human-readable label of a superhero record.
scope: Display and lookup of superheroes by their published name.

name: Hero Civilian Full Name
definition: The character's in-universe civilian or full personal name, stored in superhero.full_name. Many records do not carry a civilian identity; both an explicit dash and SQL NULL are used to encode that absence.
scope: Identity analysis of superheroes; must not be treated as a guaranteed complete attribute of every record.

name: Hero Identifier
definition: The integer surrogate that denotes one superhero record. It is authoritative in superhero.id and is reused as hero_id by the child tables that attach information to a hero, so the same identifier concept appears under different column spellings across tables.
scope: Joining superhero to its dependent records; identifier sequences are not guaranteed contiguous.

name: Publisher
definition: The company or rights holder that publishes a superhero property. Publishers form an independent reference list that many superheroes point at, so roster analysis is a many-to-one aggregation from superhero to publisher.
scope: Publisher-level roster and franchise analysis in this database.

name: Alignment
definition: The moral stance attributed to a superhero, held in a four-value reference list (Good, Bad, Neutral, N/A). It is a classification of the character, not a measured quantity.
scope: Grouping and comparing superheroes by moral stance.

name: Gender
definition: The gender category recorded for a superhero, held in a three-value reference list (Male, Female, N/A). The N/A entry is a missing-value category rather than a substantive gender.
scope: Demographic breakdowns of the superhero catalogue.

name: Race / Species
definition: The species or origin category of a superhero, held in a 61-value reference list whose entries mix everyday species labels (Human, Mutant, Alien) with compound origin labels (Human / Radiation, Human-Kree). A dash entry records an unspecified race.
scope: Species and origin breakdowns; the dash entry and NULL race_id must be handled explicitly.

name: Colour Value
definition: A colour name drawn from the shared 35-value colour reference list. The same list supplies the eye colour, hair colour and skin colour of a superhero, so the three appearance attributes are not independent vocabularies.
scope: Appearance analysis of superheroes across the eye, hair and skin colour columns.

name: Attribute Dimension
definition: One of the six rated capability dimensions of a superhero: Intelligence, Strength, Speed, Durability, Power and Combat. Dimensions are held in a fixed reference list and give meaning to the numeric ratings recorded per hero.
scope: Naming and interpretation of the six capability scores; distinct from the separately named superpower abilities.

name: Hero Attribute Score
definition: The numeric rating a single superhero receives on a single attribute dimension, stored in hero_attribute.attribute_value. It is a per-hero, per-dimension measurement and is the base quantity for any capability comparison between heroes or groups.
scope: Capability scoring and comparison; available only for heroes that have rating rows.

name: Hero Height
definition: The recorded height of a superhero in centimetres, stored in superhero.height_cm. Zero is used as a placeholder for an unrecorded height and a small number of extreme values describe cosmic-scale characters.
scope: Physical measurement analysis; zero values and extreme outliers must be excluded before averaging.

name: Hero Weight
definition: The recorded weight of a superhero in kilograms, stored in superhero.weight_kg. Zero is used as a placeholder for an unrecorded weight and a few extreme values describe cosmic-scale characters.
scope: Physical measurement analysis; zero values and extreme outliers must be excluded before averaging.

name: Superpower
definition: A named ability drawn from a 167-value reference list, such as Super Strength, Flight or Telepathy. Powers are independent entities shared across many heroes, so a hero's abilities are a many-to-many set rather than a column of the hero record.
scope: Ability analysis of superheroes; the referenced list shares some labels with attribute dimensions but describes different concepts.

name: Hero Power Count
definition: The number of distinct powers recorded for one superhero. It has no stored column and must be derived by counting the hero's rows in the hero-to-power association.
scope: Breadth-of-ability analysis per superhero; undefined for heroes with no recorded powers.

name: Publisher Roster Size
definition: The number of superhero records attributed to one publisher. It has no stored column and must be derived by counting superhero records per publisher.
scope: Publisher scale comparison; the count is only as meaningful as the publisher attribution, which is incomplete for some records.
